oracle_authority: Independently prepared evaluator-only visible-state contract derived before first-pass evaluation from frozen fixture specification/cases/scripts; no application or learner imports. No outcome labels or rule selectors are supplied to this control.

raw_design_eligibility.learner_availability: Measured separately from raw design; requires named objects, fields, adopted language and query literals.

scope: Oracle-supplied evaluator control. Saved learner outputs are inspected, never refitted or amended.
Ordinary evaluation preserves one job/resource identity and changes their numeric values; identity generalization is not tested.
Exact visible-name/source corroboration is a restricted identity control, not proof of a globally correct ontology.
Per-field correspondence can be unavailable because scorer v2 does not export attribute source nodes.
Trajectory alignment uses oracle pre-state values after preservation and is diagnostic only; no outcomes enter alignment.
A missing explicit reference is distinguished from missing correct role bindings; alternate selection/containment strategies remain inspectable.
A present comparison literal establishes learner-language availability, not learned-law correctness.
